title: 3954. Sum of Compatible Numbers in Range I

examples.explanation: The compatible integers are: x = 1, since abs(2 - 1) = 1 and 2 & 1 = 0. x = 4, since abs(2 - 4) = 2 and 2 & 4 = 0. x = 5, since abs(2 - 5) = 3 and 2 & 5 = 0. Thus, the answer is 1 + 4 + 5 = 10.
There are no compatible integers in the range [4, 6]. Thus, the answer is 0.
